name: Dropdown
description: A button that shows a menu or any content. Three methods: details/summary (click, native), popover + anchor positioning (top layer), CSS focus (div tabindex). Placement with data-side and data-align.
useWhen: A short list of actions or links behind one button (account menu, sort, more actions)
Compact filters or settings that do not need a full page
avoidWhen: Choosing one value in a form: use Select
More than ~10 items or search inside: use a combobox
Critical content that must stay visible

parts.es-dropdown__content: Content part (ul or div; add popover for method 2)

examples.title: Method 1 · details and summary
examples.description: Native HTML: the summary toggles the content on click. Open or close from JS by adding or removing the open attribute. Closes only when the summary is clicked again.

examples.title: Method 2 · popover and anchor positioning
examples.description: The content opens on the top layer, so there is no z-index or overflow issue. popovertarget points to the content id; anchor-name / position-anchor tie the content to its button. Use a unique id and anchor name per dropdown. Closes on outside click and Esc.

examples.title: Method 3 · CSS focus
examples.description: Opens while the button has focus, closes when focus leaves. The button is a div with tabindex="0" and role="button" because Safari does not focus button elements on click. Do not put elements that take focus away (such as a dialog) inside.

examples.title: Close after click
examples.description: With the focus method, blur the active element when an item is chosen.

examples.title: Menu with icons, label and divider
examples.description: Content can hold a label, icon items, keyboard hints, a divider and a destructive item (data-tone="error").

examples.title: Align: start, center, end
examples.description: data-align aligns the content to the start (default), center or end of the button. Shown forced open with data-open.

examples.title: Side: top and bottom
examples.description: data-side="top" opens above the button, bottom (default) below. Shown forced open with data-open.

examples.title: Side: left and right
examples.description: data-side="left" or "right" opens beside the button, aligned to its top (data-align moves it to center or end).

examples.title: Hover
examples.description: data-hover also opens the dropdown on pointer hover. Keep it clickable too: touch screens have no hover.

examples.title: Any content
examples.description: The content can hold anything, not only a menu. data-padded adds inner padding.
